title: DropModel
description: Defines item drop behavior when entities are destroyed.
content:
DropModel

Defines item drop behavior when entities are destroyed.

Model

Schema

JSON
{
  "drops": [
    {
      "itemId": "health_potion",
      "chance": 0.5,
      "quantity": 1
    },
    {
      "itemId": "gold_coin",
      "chance": 1.0,
      "quantity": 5
    }
  ]
}

Description

The DropModel defines what items an entity can drop when it is destroyed. It contains an array of drop entries, each specifying an item identifier, the probability of that item dropping, and the quantity to spawn. Drop chances are evaluated independently for each entry, meaning an entity can drop multiple different items from a single destruction event. This model is commonly used on enemies, destructible objects, and containers.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
dropsArray<DropEntry>An array of drop entries defining possible item drops. Each entry contains the following properties:
drops[].itemIdstringThe unique identifier of the item to drop. Must match a registered item ID in the item registry.
drops[].chancefloatThe probability of this item dropping, from 0.0 (never) to 1.0 (always).
drops[].quantityintThe number of this item to drop when the chance check succeeds.

Example

JSON
{
  "drops": [
    {
      "itemId": "ammo_pistol",
      "chance": 0.75,
      "quantity": 10
    },
    {
      "itemId": "health_pack",
      "chance": 0.25,
      "quantity": 1
    },
    {
      "itemId": "scrap_metal",
      "chance": 1.0,
      "quantity": 3
    }
  ]
}
